# Exo Browser support

Start with [Getting started and help](../docs/HELP.md) for installing, the Bar, Exo Shield, Exo Vault, importing from other browsers and extensions.

- [Download the latest release](https://github.com/UhhErix/ExoBrowser/releases/latest)
- [Report a problem or suggest a feature](https://github.com/UhhErix/ExoBrowser/issues/new/choose)
- [Report a security problem privately](https://github.com/UhhErix/ExoBrowser/security/advisories/new)

Issues are public. Remove passwords, sign-ins, addresses and other private details from screenshots and log excerpts before posting.
